name: 100-Nichikan no Princess ◆ Mou Hitotsu no Ikemen Oukyuu
original_name: 100日間のプリンセス◆もうひとつのイケメン王宮
source:
You were an ordinary office lady. Suddenly, you got caught up in an accident and arrived at the dreamland "Wysteria"...?!

Your new life as a princess, a dream you want to fulfill...
And the fateful love that only one glass shoe brings...

"I'll make you a princess..."

When your limited time as a princess ends...
What's going to happen...?
A special Cinderella story, for your eyes only...

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.cybird.appli.android.q2s&hl=en&gl=US]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你原本只是一名普通的职场女性，却突然卷入一场意外，来到了梦幻国度“威斯塔里亚”……？！

崭新的公主生活，你想要实现的梦想……
还有一只玻璃鞋牵起的命定之恋……

“我会让你成为公主……”

当这段有期限的公主生活迎来终点……
等待你的，将会是什么？
一段只属于你的特别灰姑娘故事……

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.cybird.appli.android.q2s&hl=en&gl=US]Google Play[/url]]
